's Summer 2021 batch, it does something less flashy than "marketplace" and more durable: it takes the messy, inconsistent product data of the auto-parts world and turns it into structured catalogs that machines and marketplaces can actually read.
01 / The Problem

Sell a shirt online and the hard questions are size and color. Sell a control arm and the questions multiply: which make, which model, which year, which trim, left or right, pre-facelift or post. Get one attribute wrong and the part physically will not fit. The customer returns it, the reseller eats the shipping, and everyone loses faith in buying parts online at all.

This is the fitment problem, and it is why auto-parts e-commerce lagged behind almost every other category. The data lived in spreadsheets, PDFs and the heads of veteran counter staff. Alephee's wager was that if you standardize that data once - technical specs, images, video, variants, vehicle compatibility, live stock - you unlock the whole chain behind it.
